title: Paul McCartney live: Philips Arena, Atlanta | 2005
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Philips Arena in Atlanta, Georgia, USA, on, on 20 September 2005.

It was the third show of the US Tour, which lasted for 37 dates between September and November 2005. This show was seen by 14,096 fans.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney had previously performed at the Philips Arena on 12 and 13 May 2002 for the Driving World Tour. He returned there on 15 October 2014 for the Out There Tour.
